name: risk_assessment
description: Evaluates financial risk profiles based on portfolio volatility, leverage, liquidity, and market exposure.
author: financial-services

tool_definition.name: assess_financial_risk
tool_definition.description: Calculates a composite risk score and profile for a given set of financial indicators. Returns a risk level (low/medium/high/critical), numeric score, contributing risk factors, and an actionable recommendation.

portfolio_volatility.description: Annualized portfolio volatility as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 for 25%).

debt_to_equity.description: Debt-to-equity ratio of the entity being assessed.

liquidity_ratio.description: Current ratio (current assets divided by current liabilities).

market_exposure.description: Fraction of assets exposed to volatile markets (0.0 to 1.0).
